title: Small Group: Valley of Fire & Mojave Desert from Las Vegas
includes: Professional driver-guide with you all day
Hotel pickup and drop-off - Strip and Fremont/Downtown hotels only
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nevada's oldest state park, an hour from the Strip and a world away from it.

Valley of Fire is 40,000 acres of 150-million-year-old red sandstone and some of the most photographed scenery in Nevada. Your guide takes you to Elephant Rock, Rainbow Vista and the 1930s sandstone cabins, plus two viewpoints most visitors drive straight past.

Maximum 13 guests - a van, never a coach. Hotel pickup on the Strip or Fremont, drop-off at your door. Guides in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Highlights

- Hotel pickup and drop-off from Strip and Downtown hotels
- Maximum 13 guests, never a crowd
- Elephant Rock - the park's most photographed formation
- Rainbow Vista - layered red, pink and white sandstone
- The 1930s sandstone cabins built by the CCC
- Two hidden viewpoints known only to your guide
- Park entrance fee, snack bag and unlimited water included

A half-day escape from the Strip - no car rental, no planning, no crowds.
